chapter: The 1920s road: dance style and management
title: Buck's dirty jokes and keeping him up to the public's standard
summary: Bubbles tried to break Buck of telling dirty jokes and dressing carelessly; Nierenberg asks whether others did blue material, which Bubbles denies.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: married and she didn't believe me, she thought I was jealous and I wasn't jealous at all. However, they found out. She got to the place where she would tell him that I was trying to be better than him and only trying to keep him in line to meet the public. That was my mind. Trying to keep him up to the par of the public. In dressing, appearing, and his jokes -- he used to tell jokes. He'd tell a dirty joke in front of anybody and I had to break him of that habit.
You mean he'd tell dirty jokes on stage?
No, no, how are you goin'to do that? How are you going to say that? How are you going to say that? How can you say that? How could you say that?
